fixes.explanation: Elijah and Elisha, baker! I love the confidence, I really do. Great pair of names, but you showed up at a different job site, like walking into the next bakery over with your apron on. The text names "…Haggai the prophet and Zechariah son of Iddo." (Ezra 6:14). Those two are the prophets whose prophesying went along with the building.
